attributes.residual: CLOSED, real 0, EXACT. 59/59 instructions, opcode multiset identical, five differing words: a three-atom epilogue reorder plus two words of renaming. Ours restores `lwz r0,156(r1)`, `lfd f31,144(r1)`, `lmw r25,116(r1)`; retail restores the lmw first. The three atoms load from DISTINCT stack slots into DISJOINT register sets (g0; f31; g25..g31), the region holds no store, no control instruction and no relocation, so every memory read still chains to the region entry, and r1 is never redefined -- check_permutation_dependences accepts at exit_dead=None. The two remaining words at +0xc8/+0xcc move the line-advance temporary g0->g3, machine-proven by verify_consistent_recolor with no audit escape. THIS FUNCTION IS THE CLEANEST DEMONSTRATION OF THE SCREEN-3 DEFECT recorded in claim.law.HB_two-censuses-can-both-miss-a-function-...20260901.v1: its permutation window is control-free, and cn_census rejected it only because widening the window one slot each side reaches the trailing `blr` sequence. The window webfrank actually permutes is the unwidened one.
